description: 경찰청_전국 보호구역정보 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경찰청. 이 정보는 각 보호구역의 정확한 범위와 위치를 파악하는 데 유용하며, 교통 안전 시설물 설치 및 관리, 안전 교육 자료 제작 등 다양한 분야에 활용될 수 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 경찰청. Its tags are 전국보호구역정보, 경찰, 교통안전과, 지오메트리정보, 어린이보호구역. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-05-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
